response.content: {"critique": "I checked the claim that Quillon Business Insurance is affected by the Document type problem, cited as [i:4843cee742777ad4]. The cited insight for Quillon actually reads 'Suppliers: click \"Open\" ... click \"Save\", rage x3', which contains no mention of the Document type control at all, so that account's inclusion (and the 'widespread, affecting all 6 accounts' claim) is unsupported. The remaining figures (per-account ARR values, total ARR of £6,940,000, 6 mentions across 6 accounts, all from the sessions route, Stannary's 2026-12-05 renewal, 1 renewal in 90 days, September 2026 dates) all match the fact sheet and cited insights, and the session-log quotes are reproduced accurately with quotation marks.", "verdict": "fail"}
